title: Surrounded Regions
description:
A board contains "X" and "O". Flip an "O" region to "X" only if none of its side-connected cells touches the outer border. Return the resulting board rather than returning nothing.

The output is the entire transformed array, not a count of flipped cells.

Example 1:

Input: board = [["X","X","X","X"],["X","O","O","X"],["X","X","O","X"],["X","O","X","X"]]
Output: [["X","X","X","X"],["X","X","X","X"],["X","X","X","X"],["X","O","X","X"]]

The middle region is enclosed; the border cell stays O.

Example 2:

Input: board = [["O"]]
Output: [["O"]]

A one-cell board consists entirely of border.

Example 3:

Input: board = [["X","X"],["X","X"]]
Output: [["X","X"],["X","X"]]

No O needs changing.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= rows, columns <= 100; an empty grid has no islands.
  • All rows have equal length; cells have the values stated above.
  • Only side-sharing cells are adjacent; diagonal contact does not connect them.
  • Board entries are exactly "X" or "O".
